verdict.rationale: ROCm is documented as open source, cross-platform (Linux/Windows) software stack for AMD Instinct GPUs, including kernel-level driver components, and AMD's docs explicitly market this openness for the Instinct line. Missing for 10: explicit vendor statement about open-source kernel driver modules specifically (vs. userspace ROCm stack) and independent hands-on confirmation of running MI355X entirely on upstream/open kernel drivers.
